podcast.body: Aretha Franklin performed this soulful, sexy, and sultry song on American Bandstand in June 1976. The track, from the "Sparkle" soundtrack, achieved significant commercial success, reaching number one on the Billboard Soul Chart and number 28 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1976. It was famously covered by En Vogue in 1992 on their "Funky Divas" album. "That song went to number one on the Billboard Soul Chart, number 28 on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1976."

This single from the *Sparkle* album went to number one on the R&B chart and number 28 on the Hot 100 in the summer of 1976. The song, a 1960s soul throwback written by Curtis Mayfield, was later remade in the 1990s by the girl group En Vogue. "the single, something he can feel, which, by the way, would later be remade in the 90s by Girl Group Envogue, went to number one on the R&B chart and number 28 on the Hot 100 in the summer of 76."
